title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly identifies the final answer as (c).

title: Understanding of Filters
description: Important Criteria: The student demonstrates knowledge of the function of low-pass and high-pass filters.

title: Explanation of Compensation
description: Important Criteria: The student provides reasoning for why a high-pass filter compensates for a low-pass filter.

title: Consideration of Alternatives
description: Optional Criteria: The student discusses the implications of using RC versus LC filters in compensation.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly states that an infinite series of RC filters can achieve compensation.
